boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented MSOE annual traditions, from welcome events and winter programming to a campus science-fiction convention and senior showcase.

cards.title: Welcome Week
cards.subtitle: MSOE campus · start of the academic year
cards.notes: Use the week to get oriented, meet other new students, and locate the campus services and spaces you will use during the term.
cards.short_summary: MSOE’s welcome program pairs informational and social activities for new students before classes begin.
cards.evidence_claim: MSOE describes Welcome Week as a week of informational and fun activities that helps freshmen and new students get acquainted, meet friends, find their way around campus, and settle in before classes.
cards.access_notes: Check MSOE’s event calendar for the current program and locations.

cards.title: Fraternity and Sorority Rush Weeks
cards.subtitle: MSOE campus · first three weeks of fall quarter
cards.notes: Attend only the organization introductions that interest you, and use them to ask about each group’s social, professional, and service work.
cards.short_summary: MSOE sets aside the opening three weeks of fall quarter for students to meet its fraternities and sororities.
cards.evidence_claim: MSOE identifies Fraternity and Sorority Rush Weeks as the first three weeks of fall quarter and says the organizations offer social, intellectual, professional, and philanthropic opportunities.
cards.access_notes: Consult the current MSOE calendar or campus-life office for participating organizations and event details.

cards.title: Homecoming and Family Weekend
cards.subtitle: MSOE campus · annual Raider-family gathering
cards.notes: Invite family or alumni connections to join an activity, then choose the current schedule items that match your interests and access needs.
cards.short_summary: An annual campus weekend connecting students, alumni, and family members through activities across MSOE.
cards.evidence_claim: MSOE says Homecoming and Family Weekend welcomes students, alumni, and family members to campus to connect with the MSOE community through activities across campus.
cards.access_notes: Review the current event calendar for dates, activity locations, and any registration requirements.

cards.title: Raider Spirit Week
cards.subtitle: MSOE campus · before the first hockey home opener
cards.notes: Watch campus announcements during the lead-up to hockey season, then join the listed freebie and community events that fit your schedule.
cards.short_summary: MSOE marks the approach of its first home hockey game with a week of campus spirit programming.
cards.evidence_claim: MSOE says Raider Spirit Week occurs during the week leading to the first hockey home opener and includes campus freebies and Crocktoberfest.
cards.access_notes: Dates and activities vary; verify the current listing with MSOE before attending.

cards.title: Crocktoberfest
cards.subtitle: Raider Spirit Week · MSOE campus
cards.notes: Taste the submitted crock-pot recipes and cast a vote when the event appears on the Spirit Week schedule; follow posted dietary guidance.
cards.short_summary: A Raider Spirit Week tasting where students vote on crock-pot recipes made by staff and faculty.
cards.evidence_claim: MSOE describes Crocktoberfest as a Raider Spirit Week event where students taste and vote for staff- and faculty-prepared crock-pot recipes.
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current Spirit Week schedule and ingredient or allergy information before participating.

cards.title: SUB Zero Days
cards.subtitle: MSOE campus · winter quarter
cards.notes: Look for Student Union Board announcements and select a winter activity that suits you, whether an on-campus event or an organized outing.
cards.short_summary: The Student Union Board’s winter-quarter event week includes winter-themed programming and outings.
cards.evidence_claim: MSOE states that Student Union Board hosts SUB Zero Days each winter quarter, with events including sledding, winter-themed activities, and a Bucks game outing.
cards.access_notes: Individual events and any ticketing or transportation details are announced through MSOE programming.

cards.entity_name: SUB Zero Days Fish Bowl Toss
cards.title: Fish Bowl Toss
cards.subtitle: SUB Zero Days · MSOE campus
cards.notes: Find the Student Union Board’s current event listing, review its rules, and take part in the toss only during the supervised program window.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing SUB Zero Days activity documented by MSOE as a fish-bowl toss with goldfish prizes.
cards.evidence_claim: MSOE’s Campus Life page calls the Student Union Board’s Annual SUB Zero Days Fish Bowl Toss a long-standing tradition and notes 144 goldfish won during it.
cards.access_notes: Check the current SUB Zero Days schedule and follow all event and animal-care guidance provided by MSOE.

cards.title: St. Patrick’s Week
cards.subtitle: MSOE campus · annual spring observance
cards.notes: Use the current MSOE calendar to find the week’s scheduled campus activities and choose the options that are open to students.
cards.short_summary: MSOE’s annual St. Patrick’s observance is tied by the university to the saint’s association with engineers.
cards.evidence_claim: MSOE says St. Patrick is the patron saint of engineers and that it has celebrated the holiday annually with enthusiasm since the 1930s.
cards.access_notes: Verify the current year’s schedule, locations, and participation guidance on MSOE’s event calendar.

cards.title: Concinnity
cards.subtitle: MSOE campus · science-fiction and gaming convention
cards.notes: Check the convention schedule, then build a daytime plan around the listed games, speakers, cosplay, and other programmed activities.
cards.short_summary: MSOE hosts a campus science-fiction and gaming convention organized by its MAGE student club.
cards.evidence_claim: MSOE identifies Concinnity as a science-fiction and gaming convention on its campus, hosted by MAGE, with gaming, guest speakers, living dungeons, steampunk, and cosplay.
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current convention dates, venue, schedule, and any registration details before going.

cards.title: Senior Project Showcase
cards.subtitle: MSOE campus · fall senior design culmination
cards.notes: Visit during the published showcase window to see graduating students present projects developed with faculty advisers and industry partners.
cards.short_summary: A longstanding senior-design tradition that puts graduating students’ completed work on public display.
cards.evidence_claim: MSOE calls Senior Project Showcase a longstanding senior-design tradition in which seniors work individually or in teams and display the culmination of their projects.
cards.access_notes: MSOE says the showcase occurs every fall; verify the current showcase date, location, and visitor information.
